target_customer: Consumers needing clothing alterations or tailoring at home (the YC page pitches Captain Tailor as the Uber for tailoring)
problem: Getting clothes tailored means a trip to a tailor shop; the company aimed to bring on-demand tailoring.
business_model: On-demand marketplace taking a fee on tailoring jobs (implied by the Uber for tailoring pitch)

founders.name: Puja Patel
previous_startups: ShiftDoc (per YC page, helps healthcare practices find per-diem professionals)
founders.background_notes: The YC page says she later led medical affairs and clinical development in biotech from 2020 to 2025.

founders.name: Amit Patel
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page without background.

exit.reason: No public statement found; YC marks the company Inactive.

competitors.name: zTailors
competitors.what: Men's Wearhouse founder George Zimmer's Uber for tailors app that sends a tailor to your home or office

technical_complexity.rationale: A two-sided booking marketplace; the difficulty is supply onboarding and logistics rather than software.

defensibility.rationale: No network effect at small scale and an established brand-name rival (zTailors) used the same pitch.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Nothing found about incumbents acting against the company.

market_need_then: On-demand services were in vogue in 2015 and 2017 (zTailors launched in 2015 with press coverage), but no demand figures for Bumpline or Captain Tailor were found.

branding.domain_note: bumpline.com redirects to an Atom.com name-for-sale page, so the domain is now listed for sale; no purchase history found.

brand_strength.rationale: The legal name Bumpline and the product name Captain Tailor differ and no press, community or rebrand coverage was found for either.

outcome_analysis: The cause of the shutdown is not public. The two-person team was in YC Summer 2017 with an on-demand tailoring pitch and is now Inactive; no funding, traction or press was found. The domain is for sale. No failure factor is assigned without a source for the cause.
notes: Searches for shutdown, funding, competitor and brand information returned mostly directory pages and unrelated companies (Hemster 2019, Sojo 2022, which launched after the batch and are excluded). The YC page lists Captain Tailor as the product name and New York as location in one fetch but San Francisco appears in other results; conflict unresolved. The bumpline.com fetch redirected to a for-sale page, so the site is treated as dead.
